gg_intro: Retraining the same controller recipe on a plain graph gated recurrent unit (GRU) cell, with unchanged hyperparameters, gives the same advantage in event preservation (Section~\ref{sec:gg}).
gg_abs: Retrained with the same recipe, the controller shows the same preservation advantage on a plain graph-GRU cell.
gg_verdict: For this cell too, the skip-harm controller beats the change objective and random selection in event preservation in every seed, so the advantage is not specific to the AGN-Net cell.
gg_disc: Retraining the same recipe on a plain graph-GRU cell gives the same ordering, so the advantage is not specific to the AGN-Net cell. It is most plausibly due to the training target, although we tested only two graph cells on one dataset.
gg_h1: Because the selection mechanism is independent of the cell, we also test it on the graph-GRU cell (Section~\ref{sec:gg}).
